traits.label: Proactive reconnaissance
traits.text: He personally rides to the front to assess the tactical situation when he perceives a potential vulnerability in the enemy's position.

citation.doc: Norton, The Attack and Defense of Little Round Top (1913): Warren to Farley, July 13, 1872
citation.quote: I continued on till I reached Little Round Top

traits.label: Decisive under pressure
traits.text: He immediately requests reinforcements and takes command of available troops to secure the critical position as the enemy attacks.

citation.doc: Norton, The Attack and Defense of Little Round Top (1913): Warren to Farley, July 13, 1872
citation.quote: I immediately sent a hastily written dispatch to General Meade to send a division at least to me

traits.label: Assumes responsibility
traits.text: He detaches a regiment from another brigade to defend the hill, accepting the personal risk of overriding the immediate chain of command.

citation.doc: Norton, The Attack and Defense of Little Round Top (1913): Warren to Farley, July 13, 1872
citation.quote: I took the responsibility to detach Colonel O'Rorke
